text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: One day, while I'm at the park...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Always be marvelous, no matter when or
where! ☆
You and me, we're both
marvelous! ★

text_block_list.name: Child A
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it's the marvelous lady!
Maaarvelooous!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Yoo-hoo! Today and tomorrow will be

marvelous! ☆ Oh, you're maaarvelous
too! ★

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
What?! Don't you know? Marvelous is
just that!
Marvelous! ☆

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I'm not sure what kind of response I was

expecting, but the one I get from
Marvelous
Sunday is beyond
perplexing...

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
There's not enough marvelousness in this
world!
What can I do to make it more
so?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Everything I've got? You don't have to tell me twice! Vroom, vroom! Vaaa-vrooom!
choice_data_list: Maybe go all out and tackle it head-on...?
Like, with the hype and energy of someone from Kansai...?

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text: Woohoo! I'm shifting into higher gears!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Look! I can run nonstop now!
Ahahaha! ☆
Ahahaha! ★

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I have no idea what's happening, but I do have a smile on my face after that.

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Chill, huh? Well, if that's what you want,
I'll show
you chill!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna chillax so hard, it won't be
long before
the world becomes cooler
than ice!

text_block_list.name: Marvelous Sunday
text_block_list.text:
Ooh, now I've got a big craving for some
cool
shaved ice! C'mon, let's go! ☆
Ahahaha! ★

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I have no idea what's happening, but I do have a smile on my face after that.
